title: Node security policy (signed by the internal CA)
description: What a node may connect to and accept (added 2026-11-24, protocol.md §13). Never sent bare: the hub base64-encodes this document and signs the bytes with the internal CA key (common.json#/$defs/SignedPolicy), in config_push.security and in the join response. The agent verifies the signature against the CA it pinned at join, refuses a policy for another node_id or with a serial lower than the one it holds, persists the signed form in <state_dir>/security_policy.json and re-verifies it on every start. Empty or absent pin lists mean: chain to the internal CA plus the subject rule only (older control planes).

node_id.description: The node this policy is for; a policy for another node is refused (no cross-node replay).

serial.description: Monotonic (milliseconds since the epoch when issued). The agent refuses a policy whose serial is lower than the one it holds (rollback).

hub.description: Agent hub server identity. The agent accepts a hub TLS certificate only when it chains to the internal CA and its SubjectPublicKeyInfo sha256 is listed (current key, the pre-published next key and, during a rotation grace period, the previous key).

api_layer.description: API layer identity: the only client certificate the direct-mode proxy accepts and the only server certificate the outbound tunnel accepts. Same pin rules as hub.

subjects.description: Subject rules (K=V[,K=V]) the certificate must also match.

tunnel.description: Outbound tunnel (serving mode tunnel): the agent keeps `connections` TLS 1.3 connections open to every endpoint and serves HTTP/2 requests from the API layer over them. The agent never dials an endpoint that is not listed here.

endpoints.description: host:port of every API layer tunnel listener (one per replica).

idle_timeout_seconds.description: The agent closes and redials a tunnel on which nothing (requests or the API layer's keep-alive probes) arrived for this long.

direct.description: Direct mode (proxy listening on proxy_port): connections from sources outside allowed_source_cidrs are closed before TLS; handshakes are rate limited per source address.

allowed_source_cidrs.description: API-layer egress addresses. Empty = private ranges only (10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16, 100.64/10, fc00::/7) plus loopback.

default_allowed_cidrs.description: Source CIDRs of an SSH instance started without allowed_source_cidrs. Empty = such an instance accepts nobody until CIDRs are set.

release.description: Agent self-update (protocol.md §14): ed25519 public keys of the release signing key. A staged agent binary is trusted only when a release manifest signed by one of these keys lists its sha256. Several keys allow a rotation.

items.description: Standard base64 of the 32-byte raw ed25519 public key.

interval_seconds.description: Rejected inbound attempts are summed per interval into one event(ingress_rejected).

burst_threshold.description: An interval with at least this many rejected attempts is reported with severity critical (the control plane raises an alert).
